mask_input: existing non-overlapping SAM partition; all nonempty labels before downstream gates
margin_definition: max cosine of all target terms minus max cosine of all control terms; not probability
sam_hit_policy: select each hit SAM partition unchanged; no post-recognition filtering
cropformer_hit_policy: withdraw directly overlapping CropFormer masks from all generic processing; keep only as comparison
cabinet_scope: cabinets, cupboards, wardrobes with cabinet bodies; excludes open bookshelves and storage racks
not_hit_policy: use unchanged ordinary selection rules after removing semantic SAM hits and corresponding CropFormer masks
